description: Component for monitoring a SQL database table for new or updated rows.

connection_string_env_var.label: Connection String Env Var
connection_string_env_var.description: Name of the environment variable containing the SQLAlchemy connection string

table_name.label: Table Name
table_name.description: Name of the table to monitor. Use

watermark_column.label: Watermark Column
watermark_column.description: Column used to detect new/updated rows (e.g., 'updated_at', 'created_at', 'id')

job_name.label: Job Name
job_name.description: Name of the job to trigger when new rows are detected

id_column.label: Id Column
id_column.description: Primary key column used as the run_key for deduplication.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Maximum number of rows to return per sensor evaluation

minimum_interval_seconds.label: Minimum Interval Seconds
minimum_interval_seconds.description: Minimum time (in seconds) between sensor evaluations

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Optional Dagster resource key providing a pre-configured client.

default_status.label: Default Status
default_status.description: Default status of the sensor (running or stopped)

op_name.label: Op Name
op_name.description: Op name to key the run_config under. Emitted as `{'ops': {op_name: {'config': {...}}}}`. Defaults to 'config' for backward compat, but if the target job's op is not named 'config' (e.g. an @asset or @multi_asset with a custom name), set this to the actual op name — otherwise Dagster rejects the run config with 'Received unexpected config entry "config" at path root:ops'.

source_asset_key.label: Source Asset Key
source_asset_key.description: Optional asset key (e.g. 'orders_source') to receive an AssetObservation on every tick that yields new rows. Metadata includes table, new_rows, last_event_id, last_watermark — lets an observable-source asset in the graph show a live timeline of row arrivals in the Dagster UI.

emit_materialization.description: When True (default), the sensor emits AssetMaterialization. When False, emits AssetObservation instead. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.
emit_materialization.label: Emit Materialization

name: SQL Monitor
